title: The ledger counts lanes started with the Agent tool as lanes
body:
Why: t-496nx1h (#757) attributes a PR to a lane only when its body says "headless claude session" or a lane transcript directory exists; lanes the lead starts with the Agent tool (krn-lane subagent, `bin/krn lane brief` prompt) carry neither, so the 2026-11-14 batch (#749-#757, all lanes) counts as lead and the lane/lead split is wrong.
Outcome: a PR shipped from a `bin/krn lane brief` lane carries a machine-readable lane marker (pr body or commit trailer written by `krn pr body`/`krn pr ship` when the brief set it), and the ledger counts it as lane.
Proof: ledger test on a PR body with the marker counts lane; `krn ledger --last 10` after the next lane batch shows the lanes; npm run fast PASS.
